notes: GAAP county. Governmental receipts/disbursements/transfers/fund balances from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances, Total Governmental Funds column (p5). Taxes 114,989,219 split per the 2026-11-04 evidence rules: lodging (Visitors funds, fund name) 4,632,242, gaming tax 1,356,256 (Gaming Tax Fund = Statement of Activities line), drug tax 67 (Federal Grants Fund = Statement of Activities line); the remaining 109,000,654 (General Fund and four other funds) mixes property, inheritance, motor vehicle, in-lieu, occupation and nameplate taxes whose accrual-basis Statement of Activities amounts (108,508,094) do not tie, so it stays taxes (unlabeled). Other income 4,221,915 not split (statement lines from the Total column). Transfers in 18,468,531 vs out 18,868,531: the 400,000 difference went to the internal service funds (p7). Other financing = sale of capital assets 395,053 + IT subscriptions 338,046. Only internal service funds exist (pp6-8), so business_type is null; their cash flow statement is recorded in proprietary for information. ending_cash is the governmental funds Balance Sheet 'Cash and investments' 112,192,104 (p4, combined cash and investments). governmental_net_position: beginning as restated 314,216,206 (no separate restatement line printed). Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (single Governmental Activities column, p2). Detail: every fund's budgetary-basis budget schedule: General Fund (pp9-10, department totals, not itemized), Veterans Aid sub-fund (p32), Federal Grants (p11, function public safety as a guess), and all 17 nonmajor funds (pp15-31); the General Fund combining schedule (p12) and the nonmajor combining statement (pp13-14) are not recorded because every fund has its own more detailed budget schedule (no double counting). Budget-basis tax lines stay taxes (unlabeled) except fund-name lodging and gaming funds. Lines with no actual amount (dashes) omitted. Sinking Fund prints a revenue line of 203,134 with no label. Weed control spending is natural resources/conservation; Keno spending Community Betterment (Keno fund balance committed for community betterment). Page 1 is a contents page. Read pages 1-32 of 32
